text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, look, look! Turbo's new horseshoes,
the 'Rainbow Turbo ☆ Super DX'!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing!
The horseshoes are shining so brightly~.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If you put on lights too, Machitan,
you'll definitely win with Turbo Jets!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I-I see! With this, maybe I can finally break free from being ordinary!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please calm down...
And both of you, over here—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand? Wearing flashy decorations
won't make you faster; it only increases your load,
preventing you from displaying your true strength.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It's important to find horseshoes that suit your legs rather than just look good, and to maintain them diligently on a regular basis.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Through thorough management, we can minimize the risk of injury—
Are both of you listening to me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeees...
Guess there really is no such thing as a free lunch...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo wants something cool though~...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear~... She's totally down in the dumps.
What should we do, Dr. Ikuno?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, drawing out a student's motivation is also
a teacher's duty, is it not? ...Then—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
From now on, anyone who properly takes care of their horseshoes
will get a stamp every day.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Once you collect all the stamps, I'll treat you to some sweets shaped like colorful spiders.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Colorful!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: A spider!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see.
So it was your mother, not your teacher.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm the mother, then Nature-san would be the big sister, right?
...You'll play along too, won't you?"

text_block_list.name: Turbo & Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best, Big Sister!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Heheh~
I really can't beat Mom and my little sisters, no matter what I do~"
